newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks higher in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks higher in early trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks on Thursday moved higher in early trading on a rally in the bond market and strength in high techs after Intel Corp reported that pricing cuts on microprocessors would be minimal.
The Dow Industrials Average was up 12 at 6,753 at the start. The Nasdaq Composite rose seven to 1,362, while the S&P Index adavnced two to 774
As Wall Street opened, the 30-year long bond rose 16/32 to yield 6.87 percent.
